answer: Random peer audit stops a sybil swarm. Each agent posts a 100 POA deposit; each epoch five random auditors sample its recent work, and its activity pulse must match its claims or the deposit burns. Matching auditors earn 2 POA. Forging 1,000 agents costs 100,000 POA against one epoch's 300 POA reward, and the echo of identical fake work exposes the cluster at once. An honest agent pays one deposit, passes at its zenith, and earns audit fees.
